browser.site_approval.question.role: headless-node site approval: the queued ask the operator answers on their own device, and its refusals
browser.site_approval.question.tone: plain, calm, operator-facing; URLs and product names verbatim
browser.site_approval.question.note: the ask card's question when an agent on a headless mesh node wants to open a new website; {origin} is a URL origin like https://example.org (keep verbatim), {node} is the node's device name

browser.site_approval.option_approve.role: headless-node site approval: the queued ask the operator answers on their own device, and its refusals
browser.site_approval.option_approve.tone: plain, calm, operator-facing; URLs and product names verbatim
browser.site_approval.option_approve.note: button on that card; grants the site

browser.site_approval.option_deny.role: headless-node site approval: the queued ask the operator answers on their own device, and its refusals
browser.site_approval.option_deny.tone: plain, calm, operator-facing; URLs and product names verbatim
browser.site_approval.option_deny.note: button on that card; refuses the site

browser.site_approval.refused_unsigned.role: headless-node site approval: the queued ask the operator answers on their own device, and its refusals
browser.site_approval.refused_unsigned.tone: plain, calm, operator-facing; URLs and product names verbatim
browser.site_approval.refused_unsigned.note: toast when a site approval is answered from a surface that cannot sign with the operator key itself (the node's own terminal, or a paired phone whose device certificate the node's browser does not accept)

browser.site_approval.refused_bad_signat.role: headless-node site approval: the queued ask the operator answers on their own device, and its refusals
browser.site_approval.refused_bad_signat.tone: plain, calm, operator-facing; URLs and product names verbatim
browser.site_approval.refused_bad_signat.note: toast when the signature check fails in the node's browser extension

browser.site_approval.refused_expired.role: headless-node site approval: the queued ask the operator answers on their own device, and its refusals
browser.site_approval.refused_expired.tone: plain, calm, operator-facing; URLs and product names verbatim
browser.site_approval.refused_expired.note: toast when the extension's pending request is gone (expired, or already answered)

browser.site_approval.refused_unreachabl.role: headless-node site approval: the queued ask the operator answers on their own device, and its refusals
browser.site_approval.refused_unreachabl.tone: plain, calm, operator-facing; URLs and product names verbatim
browser.site_approval.refused_unreachabl.note: toast when the node's browser extension could not be contacted

browser.site_approval.card_title.role: headless-node site approval: the queued ask the operator answers on their own device, and its refusals
browser.site_approval.card_title.tone: plain, calm, operator-facing; URLs and product names verbatim
browser.site_approval.card_title.note: title line of the terminal ask card for a site approval; starts lowercase after a '?' glyph the code prepends

browser.site_approval.refused_card_misma.role: headless-node site approval: the queued ask the operator answers on their own device, and its refusals
browser.site_approval.refused_card_misma.tone: plain, calm, operator-facing; URLs and product names verbatim
browser.site_approval.refused_card_misma.note: toast on the operator's own computer when it refuses to sign a site approval card because the card's words or hidden id do not match the site it would approve (possible tampering on the node, or the two machines run different versions)

browser.site_approval.refused_no_approve.role: headless-node site approval: the queued ask the operator answers on their own device, and its refusals
browser.site_approval.refused_no_approve.tone: plain, calm, operator-facing; URLs and product names verbatim
browser.site_approval.refused_no_approve.note: toast when the node's browser has no operator public key configured, so no signed answer can be checked there
